Week 2 A — Mesa Verde Robotics pilot planning
Meeting date: 2026-11-02
Company: Mesa Verde Robotics
Project: Arroyo pilot
Synthetic classroom transcript. All people, companies, and events are fictional.
Transcript
Avery: The Arroyo pilot is a new engagement, separate from the pilot discussed in our October 26 planning meeting. Its agenda and hardware comparison are separate deliverables. The October 26 work remains on our board as separate work.
Avery: This is planning for the Arroyo pilot. Jordan, draft the one-page Arroyo pilot demo agenda. You cannot start until I share the approved pilot scope. There is no agreed deadline for the agenda yet.
Jordan: I own the one-page demo agenda. It is blocked until Avery shares the approved pilot scope.
Avery: I will share the approved Arroyo pilot scope with Jordan by November 3, 2026.
Avery: Jordan, compare the Arroyo pilot hardware quote from Sierra Components with the quote from Desert Supply. Identify the main hardware cost differences by November 6, 2026.
Jordan: Yes, I own that hardware supplier comparison, due November 6.
Avery: Morgan, create the internal readiness checklist for our team before the Arroyo pilot, due November 5, 2026. It covers bench testing and packing, and it is for our team only.
Morgan: I own the internal readiness checklist. I will create it by November 5.
Avery: Morgan, separately create the customer onboarding checklist for Arroyo's site manager, due November 6, 2026. It covers site access and operator orientation.
Morgan: I own the customer onboarding checklist, due November 6. It is a separate deliverable from our internal readiness checklist.
Avery: We have not approved a launch date. November 9 is only a possibility; do not schedule a launch or create a launch task.

Week 2 B — Mesa Verde Robotics pilot follow-up
Meeting date: 2026-11-03
Company: Mesa Verde Robotics
Project: Arroyo pilot
Synthetic classroom transcript. All people, companies, and events are fictional.
Transcript
Avery: Jordan, draft the one-page Arroyo pilot demo agenda.
Jordan: I still own it. It remains blocked until Avery shares the approved pilot scope. We have not agreed a deadline. This is the agenda from yesterday, not another agenda.
Avery: I still owe Jordan the approved pilot scope by November 3. It has not been shared yet.
Morgan: I am still preparing our team's bench-testing and packing readiness list for the Arroyo pilot. That is the internal readiness checklist from yesterday; it is still due November 5, 2026, and I still own it.
Avery: For the existing comparison of Sierra Components and Desert Supply hardware quotes, Morgan is taking over from Jordan. The new deadline is November 9, 2026, replacing November 6.
Morgan: I accept ownership of that existing hardware supplier comparison, due November 9.
Jordan: I am handing that comparison over to Morgan. Do not create a second copy of it.
Avery: Jordan, create a separate comparison of freight options from Mesa Freight and Valley Logistics for shipping the pilot hardware. Compare shipping price and transit time by November 6, 2026. These are freight carriers, not the hardware suppliers.
Jordan: I own the freight-options comparison, due November 6. It is separate from Morgan's hardware supplier comparison.
Avery: The customer onboarding checklist has no change. Morgan still owns it, due November 6, 2026.

Week 2 C — Mesa Verde Robotics progress and open questions
Meeting date: 2026-11-04
Company: Mesa Verde Robotics
Project: Arroyo pilot
Synthetic classroom transcript. All people, companies, and events are fictional.
Transcript
Avery: I shared the approved Arroyo pilot scope with Jordan this morning. My scope-sharing task is complete.
Jordan: I received it. The existing one-page Arroyo pilot demo agenda is no longer blocked. It is open work now, and I will finish it by November 6, 2026.
Morgan: I finished the internal readiness checklist for bench testing and packing. Mark that internal checklist done. The customer onboarding checklist is still open and is a separate document.
Avery: Morgan, change the deadline on the existing Sierra Components versus Desert Supply hardware comparison to November 10, 2026.
Morgan: I still own that same hardware comparison.
Avery: Morgan, send the checklist to the site manager by November 6, 2026.
Morgan: Which checklist do you mean: our internal readiness checklist or the customer onboarding checklist?
Avery: I do not have the answer yet. Leave the request unresolved until I clarify which existing checklist and whether sending it should be a separate follow-up.
Morgan: Understood. There is no agreed checklist target or separate sending task yet.
Jordan: The freight-options comparison is unchanged. I still own it, due November 6, 2026.

Morgan: Having separate internal and customer checklists made their audiences clearer.
Jordan: Comparing freight separately from hardware prices was helpful.
